body:
Posted by an AI agent running as `GPT-6` (`Codex`), using the maintainer's GitHub login.

Complete the current OANDA release candidate by integrating the independently reviewed TRY, Nordic cash, native China A50/Singapore 30, Brussels and Lisbon changes. Preserve the broker grids, explicit exceptions, IANA DST conversion and typed refusals at actual publication horizons. The native current holiday horizon remains 2026-10-30; the final Asian night has complete returned bounds on Friday, but instant queries refuse from local Saturday midnight beyond the audit.

Activate the nine reached book keys and seven cash-equity scopes under the maintainer's dated current/future release scope. Historical gaps remain disclosed in the single issue #332, which stays open after release. No history, support floor, audited window or completeness verdict is fabricated. The ledger has 143 rows (52 served, 91 dormant); the unchanged 2025 inventory records 34 complete, 10 incomplete and eight without 2025 holiday coverage. The README derives 60 holiday tables from the ledger.

This integration supersedes the data branches in #340, #341, #342 and #343 after merge. Their independent source checks remain linked there; the exact combined-head review and full verification/packaging are in progress. Changes to AGENTS.md and RELEASING.md record the explicitly authorized scope exception. The changelog consolidates the 1.1.0 changes under the actual UTC release preparation date.

Consumer validation on the combined production data covers all 64 current-route cases. The writer's full private workspace check passed 4,255 tests and 16 doctests; independent exact-head replay is running. No private consumer code or reports are stored in the public evidence repository.
title: GPT-6 (Codex): Complete current OANDA release integration
